fichas.title: Shooting range safety and site planning
fichas.summary: Guidance on elevation safety, protection of endangered areas, site suitability, approvals, future extensions, and noise protection. A specialist should be consulted when assessing a proposed site. Open-air ranges should include noise protection measures.
